name: plugin.hf_doc_builder
description: Hugging Face doc-builder integration for AST autodoc inspection, deterministic link checking, MDX transpilation, and semantic chunking
author: Brain Harness

entrypoints.name: doc_autodoc_inspect
entrypoints.description: Extract structured signatures, type hints, parameter docs, and markdown from Python objects

parameters.name: package_name
parameters.description: Target Python package or module name

parameters.name: object_name
parameters.description: Target class, function, or method name

parameters.name: mock_heavy_deps
parameters.description: Whether to intercept and mock uninstalled heavy dependencies via sys.meta_path

entrypoints.name: doc_link_verify
entrypoints.description: Verify internal relative links, anchors, and cross-references across documentation files

parameters.name: check_anchors
parameters.description: Whether to verify heading anchor fragments

entrypoints.name: doc_format_convert
entrypoints.description: Transpile Markdown, RST, or Jupyter Notebooks into MDX with Svelte tags

parameters.name: source_path
parameters.description: Path to source document or raw markdown string

entrypoints.name: doc_style_lint
entrypoints.description: Lint and format code examples inside docstrings and MDX files

entrypoints.name: doc_chunk_indexer
entrypoints.description: Hierarchically partition documentation by headings with breadcrumbs for vector indexing

parameters.name: max_chunk_size
parameters.description: Maximum character threshold before flushing chunk
